𝗥𝗨𝗧𝗛𝗘𝗥𝗙𝗢𝗥𝗗 𝟰𝟬 𝗢𝗙𝗙 𝟭𝟯! 🔥

Royal Desert Champions chase 124 in 9.1 overs, beating UAE Bulls by 6 wkts in Abu Dhabi T10.
Waseem 35* off 18 seals their first win.

T10 fireworks 💥

👉 Muhammad Waseem 35* off 18 — Champions ki season ki pehli jeet
